date.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the Europe/Madrid timezone. Resolve relative expressions such as tomorrow or next Monday before calling the tool.

timePreference.description: Preferred part of the day. Use morning for 10:00-14:00, afternoon for 16:00-18:00, or any when the caller has no preference.

function.description: Checks the business Google Calendar for available 30-minute discovery call slots on a specific date. Use this tool only after the caller has provided a preferred date. Never invent availability without calling this tool.
